title: Move the per-turn check state off EngramSessionState into an EngramTurnCheckState owned by engram_turn_checks.rs
outcome: Round-17 review (Claude, tm-winf steps 2+3). engram_host_adapter.rs is ~6,760 lines, more than twice the ~3,000-line Rust module guideline, and steps 2+3 add ~330 lines to it, largely the per-turn check fields on EngramSessionState (active_turn_checks, running_command_keys, running_command_worktrees, workdir_worktree, capture_workers, withheld_command_keys, next_turn_check_sequence, shell_directory) and their resets at the grant mirror. Group them in one EngramTurnCheckState struct defined and reset in engram_turn_checks.rs, so the adapter stops growing and the per-turn reset lives in one place. src/tests/engram_host_adapter.rs (~16.5k lines) is also far past the test-file guideline.
